title: Retain permissions during Dynamics SL cloud migration

facts.text: By default, cloud migration removes permission sets from existing online users except SUPER users and reassigns to Intelligent Cloud.
Users can keep original permissions during migration using Cloud Migration Management page action or custom extension.
To retain permissions, open Cloud Migration Management page and select Actions then Enable/Disable Removing Permissions from Users.
Alternative method uses custom extension with event subscriber to prevent permission reset during migration.
